title: Safar phuphiyan di peshi di
body:
Safar phuphiyan di peshi di
<<MINI>>
Haye zainab haye shaam -2
<<DIVIDER>>
Sajjad ne puri zindagi wich ro roke wayne paaye-2
May maut to aakhe jeevan de ae saare waqat nibhaye
Safar phupiyan di peshi de sunane pay gaye menu - 3
Chupane san zakhm jede - 2
<<DIVIDER>>
wakhane pay gaye menu
Kado koi veer zinda si meda laasha uthawan lai
Medi gurbat ke jangla wich jado koi baal marya si
Janaze apni phupiyan to -2
<<DIVIDER>>
Chupane pay gaye menu
Bazarich apni phupiyan layi ki tu chacha mai le aanda
Odi bawa to sadqe kis tarah abbas ban jaanda
Bada roya jado majme-2
<<DIVIDER>>
Hatane pay gaye menu
Jigar akbar da neze to chudaya mere babene
Musibat hor ki hoyi ke safra wich sakina de
Shimr to baal khud aapi - 2
<<DIVIDER>>
Chudane pay gaye menu
Hoyi jado sangbaari tay meri behna bichad gaiyaan
Bada gayyur ha lekin sadawa deni aa paiyaan
Bazaarech naam behna de -2
<<DIVIDER>>
Bulane pay gaye menu
Kite pehchaan na le hind ae zainab ye zehra di
Hanera shaam wale qaid khane da wadha wan layi
Jede do chaar dive san - 2
<<DIVIDER>>
Bujaane pay gaye menu
Ae wayn aabid de sayn akbar bhira je koi na bachya
Kithe jhula kithe sehra musalla kidre may rakhiye
Ine dadi de chaalighar -2
<<DIVIDER>>
Wasaane pay gaye menu
<<MINI>>
Haye zainab haye shaam - 2
